description: This file contains a series of shell commands that serve as tests for the 'git worktree prune' functionality. It defines various test cases to verify the behavior of pruning worktrees under different scenarios, including invalid directories, unreadable gitdirs, non-existent locations, locked checkouts, recent checkouts, and duplicates.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks that a given path is a directory.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file or output is empty.
